text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others do not? I also need to know if you have a history of substance use, particularly cannabis or hallucinogens.

text: My main symptom is Belief in telepathic communication with animals. I also have Ingestion of Peruvian herbs, No improvement with self-medication.

text: Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, social withdrawal, or decline in occupational functioning over the last eight months? I would also like to rule out organic causes, so REQUEST TEST: Urine Drug Screen and REQUEST TEST: Basic Metabolic Panel.

text: Given the normal lab results and the persistence of these bizarre delusions for eight months, are you currently experiencing any negative symptoms like flat affect, avolition, or significant social isolation? speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Patient is not on any medication and has no significant past medical history. Social history: Lives alone, works at a health food store. Dresses in all burlap clothing and attempts telepathic communication during history taking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any other hallucinations, such as hearing voices that comment on your actions or comment on your thoughts? I also need to know if there is any family history of psychiatric disorders like schizophrenia or bipolar disorder.
